stem.text: The diagram shows the pressure changes in various structures of the left side of the heart during the cardiac cycle.

stem.alt: Line graph of pressure in kPa against time in s from 0 to 0.8 for the left ventricle, aorta and left atrium, with four periods marked A, B, C and D along the time axis. Key: dashed line left ventricle, solid line aorta, dotted line left atrium.

stem.text: At the end of which period is the ventricle full of blood?
